title: LoadSolutionFile and the SolutionViewer fail for a model without coordinates
author: Claude-JG
description: a model of ground objects moved by a PreStepUserFunction (tmp/ex02b_exudyn_bewegtes_KS.py) writes a solution file with the time column only; np.loadtxt returns a 1D array, so LoadSolutionFile and the SolutionViewer fail unless a mass point is added; also a file with one data row
releaseNotes: LoadSolutionFile reads a solution file with the time column only - of a model without coordinates, such as ground objects moved by a PreStepUserFunction - and a file with one row as a matrix, so the SolutionViewer shows such a model
